summary: Wrote a 6-phase linear implementation plan for making a freshly initialized repository land with its whole specs tree gitignored. The design adopts the research report's root-level managed-block approach gated on git ls-files -- specs/ being empty, and expands scope beyond the three originally declared files to fold in check-runtime-file-tracking.sh's Check C and both affected test suites, because plan authoring found test-init-specs.sh Case 6 is a live break under the new default rather than the optional follow-on the report had described. The final phase's negative control asserts the reference repository's tracked specs tree is untouched against the git index, not against any script's exit code.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan: lib renderer, init-specs.sh fresh-repo detection and root-level /specs/ managed block, posture-aware Check C, both-posture tests, standards posture split plus manual opt-in runbook, redeploy with an index-asserted negative control.
